component.name: LettersFall 110%
component.summary: Educational American English word spelling game with falling letters

description.p: When you combine the video game Tetris with the board game Scrabble you get LettersFall 110%! Letters rapidly fall and you must correctly spell American English words to clear them.

Features nice graphics, good sound effects, and a great music soundtrack. Also has easy to play mouse controls and fun and challenging gameplay. Plus multiple game modes with varying difficulty and a saved high score table for each mode.
Includes a 450,000+ word American English dictionary. Do you have the skills to battle your way to the end and win? "Learn To Have Fun!"
